segments.name: welcome
segments.title: Welcome screen
segments.caption: White page, squarer buttons and a squarer Paste key. Command chips sit in flat grey wells with a hairline, in IBM Plex Mono.

segments.name: server
segments.title: New Server form
segments.caption: Labels sit above 48 dp fields with 8 dp corners and a 1 dp border; focus is a near-black ring. Sheets get 16 dp corners and a quiet handle.

segments.name: story
segments.title: Welcome story
segments.caption: The illustration now shows an Android phone with Android wording. Get Started is a black button instead of periwinkle.

segments.name: transcript
segments.title: Transcript
segments.caption: Tables size to fit, and the next column peeks under an edge fade to show it scrolls. Hairline code blocks; the title bar gets a hairline on scroll.

segments.name: tools
segments.title: Tool groups
segments.caption: Icons and bold tool names; the failed edit uses a calmer red. Shell output sits in a white well with a hairline.

segments.name: composer
segments.title: Composer and + menu
segments.caption: A white floating card with a hairline and shadow; Send is a black square. The + menu is the same popover as the session menu, with bare line icons.

segments.name: model
segments.title: Model picker
segments.caption: The search field matches the forms: white, 8 dp corners, 1 dp border, instead of a grey pill. Black actions instead of blue.

segments.name: drawer
segments.title: Drawer
segments.caption: Search, New Session and Settings are white floating buttons with a hairline and shadow. The unread dot and Catch Up stay blue.

segments.name: settings
segments.title: Settings
segments.caption: Server card and groups share a hairline and 10 dp corners. The title collapses into a flat bar with a hairline. Switches: outlined off, black on.

segments.name: prompts
segments.title: Permission and question cards
segments.caption: Crisp white cards with a hairline. Deny has 8 dp corners instead of a capsule; the question's close X is a plain glyph.

segments.name: voice
segments.title: Voice call
segments.caption: The card steps off the page with a hairline and shadow; controls are rounded squares and End is the theme red. The orb is unchanged, as on iOS.

segments.name: dark
segments.title: Dark theme
segments.caption: The same flat surfaces, hairlines and black-and-white actions carry over to dark.
